meta.text:
I'll sort the flight options by price, but I can't yet: the card has never rendered. My last two ui_apply calls were rejected. The first sent no ops, and the second put a canvas inside another node, which the schema doesn't allow. The flight options were never created, so there's nothing on screen to reorder.

I'll rebuild the card in one ui_apply call, with the three options written in ascending price order from the start. That way the list is sorted by price. Each option will carry its own times, airline, direct or stop status, duration, price, and tags for the cheapest and the best time. The first option stays selected, the total updates with the selection, and the confirm button reports which flight was picked.
